description: Use this when someone asks about flights, flight prices, airfare or cheap plane tickets between two airports or cities (for example Seoul to Tokyo; find_airports turns a city into its airports). Returns the fares for one airport pair: the cheapest one-way, the cheapest round trip of a 3 to 21 day stay, a fare calendar of the cheapest one-way by departure date, the cheapest one-way in each month, and the cheapest round trips. A one-way may carry typical_price, the route's typical one-way fare, and pct_below_typical. When the pair has no fares yet, it looks the route up; if the fares are not back in time it answers status "pricing", and asking again a minute later reads them.

from.description: where the flight leaves from: origin IATA airport code (an airport, not a city code)

month.description: YYYY-MM: keep only departure dates in that month

to.description: where the flight lands: destination IATA airport code

found_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day this fare was found; absent when only checked is known
